recent_articles.title: US launches new strikes on Iran, targeting missile sites and boats
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **US** launched new strikes on Iranian missile sites and boats in southern Iran, claiming it was taking action to protect its troops from threats posed by Iranian forces.  **Iran** has yet to respond to the attack, but Iranian foreign ministry spokesman Esmail Baqai stated that while progress had been made in talks to end the war, a deal is not imminent. **US Secretary of State Marco Rubio** said a deal was still possible and pointed to ongoing discussions between Iran's top negotiator and foreign minister and Qatar's prime minister.  However, Baqai cautioned against making claims about an imminent agreement. The strikes occurred near Bandar Abbas, home to an Iranian naval base on the Strait of Hormuz, which has been closed by **Iran** since the start of the conflict in February.

recent_articles.title: Drunken brawl turns deadly: Labourer beaten to death near construction site, accused arrested - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Whitefield police** have upgraded a suspected accidental death case to murder after discovering evidence of a fatal assault near an under-construction building in Kundalahalli. recent_articles.rephrased_article: **CBI** registered an FIR in the Twisha Sharma dowry death case on May 25, 2026, after taking over from the Bhopal Police. recent_articles.title: Court allows police interrogation of Shiv Sena MLA Sanjay Gaikwad over threat to publisher - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Kolhapur** court has granted permission for police to question Shiv Sena MLA Sanjay Gaikwad in connection with threats made against publisher Prashant Ambi regarding the book "Who was Shivaji?".  Gaikwad, who had previously objected to the use of the word "Shivaji" in the book and threatened Ambi, now regrets his abusive language but maintains he will continue to oppose books critical of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. The incident dates back to 1988 when the book was published, and Mr. Ambi has received threatening calls since then.  The case is expected to proceed with a notice issued by the Rajarampuri police station directing Gaikwad to appear for questioning or submit a written response.

recent_articles.title: Trump renews petition for White House ballroom, pointing to nearby shooting | Donald Trump News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Trump** administration is renewing its push to lift a court ruling barring construction of the White House ballroom, citing security concerns following a recent shooting near the White House. Acting Attorney General **Todd Blanche** argued in court filings that the incident underscores the need for top-level security at the White House and that the ballroom project is necessary for the President's safety. However, the project faces opposition from members of Congress who have questioned its price tag and lack of transparency.  The judge, Richard Leon, previously issued a temporary injunction against construction, requiring the Trump administration to petition Congress for approval.

recent_articles.title: ‘A tsunami of harm’: views on tackling online safety for under-16s in the UK | Social media ban | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The UK government is considering stricter regulations for social media platforms, particularly concerning under-16s.  **Ian Russell**, father of Molly Russell, a prominent online safety campaigner, advocates for more nuanced restrictions on platforms that fail to meet safety standards, potentially blocking access for those users. **Esther Ghey**, whose daughter Brianna was murdered due to social media addiction, supports raising the age limit and curbing addictive features like infinite scrolling.  **Fin**, a 17-year-old student, criticizes blanket bans and calls for more nuanced approaches with varying levels of restrictions. The government is also considering stricter age verification measures and regulating advertising practices. **Colm Gannon**, from the International Centre for Missing and Exploited Children Australia, argues against an outright ban in favor of safety parameters and parental controls.  **Doniya Soni-Clark**, from TechUK, represents major social media platforms and believes that focusing on unsafe features instead of banning entire platforms is a better approach.

recent_articles.title: One killed as shed collapses due to gusty winds in Peddapalli district - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A **shepherd**, Lakshmaiah, 57, was killed when a shed collapsed on him in Gollapalli village, Odela mandal of Peddapalli district. Several parts of Peddapalli and Karimnagar districts experienced the sudden downpour, leaving some paddy stored at a procurement center soaked.
